snippet.title: NTE Version 1.4 PV | For Whom the Verses Mourn
snippet.description:
Where are we? Happy sounds are ringing in my ears.
So many attractions tugging at my hand!
Put down your worries, just have some fun. 
Especially casted for you, a spell to make you smile.
It will never, ever end.

NTE V1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" launches September 30 with new Limited S-Class Characters Blackbird & Akane Rin. Download today: https://nte.onelink.me/9g76/ia3mr5k3
